title.narrative: Apoyo al Programa de Reformas del Sector Transporte y Logstica de Panam III
Support For Panama's Transport and Logistics Sector Reform Program III

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es contribuir a la mejora del desempeo logstico de Panam, a travs de la reduccin derestricciones normativas e institucionales que limitan el desempeo del pas especialmente en los mbitos de: (i) ServiciosLogsticos de Valor Agregado (SLVA); (ii) logstica de apoyo al sector agrcola; y (iii) logstica de apoyo al comercio regional.Los objetivos especficos del programa son: (i) fortalecimiento del marco legal y regulatorio; (ii) consolidacin del marcoinstitucional de logstica y transporte; y (iii) fortalecimiento del sistema de planificacin multisectorial y de facilitacin comercial,que contribuirn a una mejor planificacin de la inversin en el sector de logstica y transporte, la ampliacin del rea logsticautilizada, a la reduccin del tiempo de despacho de mercancas y a la provisin de recursos humanos en el rea de logstica.El presente prstamo es el tercero y ltimo de una serie de operaciones, vinculadas tcnicamente entre s, pero financiadasen forma independiente, bajo la modalidad de Prstamo Programtico de Apoyo a Reformas de Polticas, PBP por sus siglasen ingls (CS-3633-1).

The objective of the program is to help improve Panama's logistics performance by reducing regulatory andinstitutional restrictions that limit the country's performance, primarily in the following areas: (i) value-added logisticsservices (VALS); (ii) logistics that support the agriculture sector; and (iii) logistics that support regional trade. The program'sspecific objectives are to: (i) strengthen the legal and regulatory framework; (ii) consolidate the institutional framework fortransport and logistics; and (iii) strengthen the multisector planning and trade facilitation system, which will help to improveinvestment planning in the transport and logistics sector, expand the surface area devoted to logistics in use, reduce thecustoms clearance time of goods, and provide human resources for the logistics area.This is the third and final loan in a series of technically related but separately financed operations under the programmaticpolicy-based loan (PBP) modality (document CS-3633-1).
Commitment in 2018-07-18
Disbursement in third quarter of 2018
